steps.headline: Weimar: forest city, water-wise, almost car-free
steps.outlook: Weimar became a forest city powered by sun and rain, where children walk tree-lined paths to schools that teach by the Ilm's recovering banks, and nearly everyone bikes or takes transit, except one stubborn driver in an electric SUV who remembers the car age fondly.

observed.pattern: Rainwater collected by all, attics insulated as standard, e-bikes haul goods and children, river teaches classes, one driver still resists
observed.assumption: Final habits lock in: water autonomous, heat avoided through shade, logistics electric, river restored, culture almost universal but not quite

changes.title: Water: harvest not tap
changes.story: Every building collects and filters rainwater. Mains supply 20 percent. Drought-proof by design.

changes.title: All old houses sealed
changes.story: Entire town retrofitted. Attics insulated, heat loss minimal. Heating costs fell 70 percent since 2031.
